scope: All 57 residual East-shaped sootv- tokens in the live v019 Latin reader: three in 44-book and 54 in base-papers1-43.
choice: Replace 23 finite correspondence predicates and 23 inflected correspondence modifiers with the already-established official odgovarj-/odgovarjajuč- family; replace two Zuordnung nouns with korespondencija; render six genuinely analogous discourse uses with analogično; and explicitly recast three ordered/respective constructions instead of forcing them into the same lexical family.
motivation: The residual sootv- layer duplicated the correspondence policy already established in EDIT-0021 while preserving a Russian-shaped root and several malformed agreement endings. A single blind stem substitution would still mistranslate German beziehungsweise/jeweils and would leave noun and discourse-adverb functions collapsed. The context-sensitive closure removes the root while preserving each mathematical relation and its grammar.
alternatives_rejected: Retain sootv- as an intelligible but East-shaped technical doublet; this leaves the exact dominant-language collapse the edition is required to remove.
Apply one global sootv-to-odgovarj stem replacement; this would produce malformed noun/adverb forms and obscure German beziehungsweise and jeweils.
Use korespondencija for every predicate and modifier; this would nominalize ordinary mathematical correspondence relations and make the prose heavier.
Use odnosno or a borrowed respektivno at all ordered sites; explicit first/second, po redu, and each-of-them recasts are clearer and avoid adding an unsupported catch-all marker.

prior_policy.rule: Preserve valid technical correspondence verbs while using official odgovarjajuč- modifiers and korespondencija nouns.

official_grammar.rule: Participial modifiers decline as soft adjectives and agree in gender, case, and number; the intervention repairs inherited -tny/-čno endings accordingly.

german_meaning_authority.semantic_split: entsprechen/entsprechend predicates and modifiers; Zuordnung nouns; dementsprechend/entsprechend analogous discourse; beziehungsweise/jeweils ordered relations

validation.protected_spans: zero targets in TeX comments or foreign-language arguments; protected bytes unchanged
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: frozen dry-run output hashes reproduced immediately before atomic apply
